raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Add an opt-in ROCm compile pass that fuses an unquantized GEMM into the residual add + RMSNorm that consumes it
(`-cc.pass_config.fuse_gemm_add_rms=True`, compile ranges of at most 256 tokens). When the GEMM runs as an AITER Triton
split-K GEMM, the fp32 partials go straight into AITER's `fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm`, so the split-K reduce kernel and
the add + RMSNorm kernel become one kernel. 

See the companion AITER PR: https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6678

## Claims

- Qwen3.8-27B BF16, TP1, MI355X, 1024×1024: per decoder layer, the split-K reduce (4.5 µs) and the add + RMSNorm (4.7 µs) after o_proj / out_proj become one 4.6 µs kernel.
- The gain needs a GEMM that splits K at decode sizes. Here, the AITER Triton config for N=5120, K=6144 (Qwen3.8 o_proj
  and out_proj) uses 3 splits for M 9–64. Where the GEMM does not split K (e.g. down_proj on hipBLASLt), the pass only
  swaps Inductor's add + RMSNorm for the AITER kernel at the same launch count.
- Off by default at every optimization level; no change for CUDA, XPU or other ROCm configurations.

## Validation

MI355X, `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly` from 2026-10-05 (vLLM 92044241a0, aiter 0.1.24.post1 + the companion op +
tuned Qwen3.8 bf16 GEMM configs). Both sides run the same ROCm stack (ROCM_AITER_FA, shuffled KV layout, inductor graph partition, QK-norm/MRoPE/KV-cache fusion); the PR side adds `-cc.pass_config.fuse_gemm_add_rms=True`.

| Concurrency | | Baseline | PR | Δ |
|--:|--|--:|--:|--:|
| 4 | Total tok/s | TBD | TBD | TBD |
| | Mean TPOT (ms) | TBD | TBD | TBD |
| | Mean TTFT (ms) | TBD | TBD | TBD |
| 16 | Total tok/s | TBD | TBD | TBD |
| | Mean TPOT (ms) | TBD | TBD | TBD |
| | Mean TTFT (ms) | TBD | TBD | TBD |
| 32 | Total tok/s | TBD | TBD | TBD |
| | Mean TPOT (ms) | TBD | TBD | TBD |
| | Mean TTFT (ms) | TBD | TBD | TBD |
| 64 | Total tok/s | 6284.4 | 6341.3 | +0.9% |
| | Mean TPOT (ms) | 19.17 | 18.99 | −0.9% |
| | Mean TTFT (ms) | 1236.4 | 1232.6 | -0.3% |
| — | GSM8K flexible / strict (5-shot, n = 1319) | 0.7248 / 0.6990 | 0.7278 / 0.6998 | - |

From torch-profiler trace (1024×64):

Before:

[PERFETTO TRACE IMAGE WILL GO HERE]

After:

[PERFETTO TRACE IMAGE WILL GO HERE]

Tests: `tests/compile/passes/test_rocm_aiter_gemm_add_rms_fusion.py` (plain RMSNorm and GemmaRMSNorm) checks three
matches, that the norm kernel receives 3-D split-K partials, that Gemma norms take the Gemma form, and numerics against
the unfused model: 2 / 2 pass on MI355X.

Reproduce:
```
# vLLM Serve
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA --language-model-only --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
    -cc.use_inductor_graph_partition=True -cc.pass_config.fuse_gemm_add_rms=True

# vLLM Bench
vllm bench serve --model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 \
    --random-range-ratio 0 --ignore-eos --num-prompts 640 --max-concurrency <4/16/32/64> --temperature 0.0 --top-p 1.0
```

## Details

- `rocm_unquantized_gemm_impl` becomes a wrapper over `_rocm_unquantized_gemm(..., skip_reduce=False)`.
  Only the two branches that reach AITER's Triton `gemm_a16w16` honour `skip_reduce`: the direct Triton branch, and the
  tuned (`tgemm`) branch when AITER's tuned config for the shape says `triton`. Those return the `[num_ksplit, M, N]`
  fp32 partials; every other branch returns the normal output. The registered `rocm_unquantized_gemm` op is unchanged.
- `rocm_aiter_gemm_add_rmsnorm(x, weight, residual, norm_weight, eps, gemma_norm)` runs the GEMM with
  `skip_reduce` and passes the result (partials or the reduced output) to `fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm`.
- Pattern matches `rocm_unquantized_gemm` → `vllm_ir.fused_add_rms_norm`, for RMSNorm and GemmaRMSNorm. The plain form requires the weight dtype to equal the activation dtype (`_rms_input_weight_dtype_match`), so it never binds Gemma's fp32 `(w + 1)` and leaves the `+1` as a separate kernel. Runs before the RMSNorm + quant passes.
- Compile ranges up to 256 tokens: decode, where split-K configs apply. Prefill keeps Inductor's kernels.

@@ -0,0 +1,161 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+import vllm.config
+from tests.compile.backend import TestBackend
+from vllm._aiter_ops import is_aiter_found_and_supported, rocm_aiter_ops
+from vllm.compilation.passes.fx_utils import find_op_nodes
+from vllm.compilation.passes.utility.noop_elimination import NoOpEliminationPass
+from vllm.compilation.passes.utility.post_cleanup import PostCleanupPass
+from vllm.config import (
+    CompilationConfig,
+    CompilationMode,
+    ModelConfig,
+    PassConfig,
+    VllmConfig,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.layernorm import GemmaRMSNorm, RMSNorm
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.utils import rocm_unquantized_gemm
+
+
+class TestModel(torch.nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, num_layers: int, hidden_size: int, k: int, gemma_norm: bool):
+        super().__init__()
+        norm_cls = GemmaRMSNorm if gemma_norm else RMSNorm
+        self.norm = [norm_cls(hidden_size, eps=1e-6) for _ in range(num_layers)]
+        for norm in self.norm:
+            torch.nn.init.normal_(norm.weight, std=0.1)
+        self.weight = [torch.randn(hidden_size, k) / k**0.5 for _ in range(num_layers)]
+
+    def forward(self, x, residual):
+        # avoid having graph inputs be pattern args directly
+        x = torch.relu(x)
+        residual = torch.relu(residual)
+        outs = []
+        for norm, weight in zip(self.norm, self.weight):
+            h = rocm_unquantized_gemm(self, x, weight)
+            out, residual = norm(h, residual)
+            outs.append(out)
+        return residual, *outs
+
+    def ops_in_model_before(self):
+        return [
+            torch.ops.vllm.rocm_unquantized_gemm.default,
+            torch.ops.vllm_ir.fused_add_rms_norm,
+        ]
+
+    def ops_in_model_after(self):
+        return [rocm_aiter_ops.get_gemm_add_rmsnorm_op()]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.bfloat16])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_layers", [3])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("gemma_norm", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fused_op_available", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_tokens", [16])
+# AITER's gfx950 Triton config for N=256, K=7168 splits K at M <= 16.
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("hidden_size, k", [(256, 7168)])
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not is_aiter_found_and_supported(),
+    reason="Only test on ROCm with AITER installed and supported",
+)
+def test_fuse_gemm_add_rms(
+    dtype: torch.dtype,
+    num_layers: int,
+    gemma_norm: bool,
+    fused_op_available: bool,
+    num_tokens: int,
+    hidden_size: int,
+    k: int,
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+):
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+    if not on_gfx950():
+        pytest.skip("The AITER tuned GEMM dispatch is gfx950-only")
+
+    vllm_config = VllmConfig(
+        model_config=ModelConfig(dtype=dtype),
+        compilation_config=CompilationConfig(
+            mode=CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE,
+            custom_ops=["+rms_norm"],
+            pass_config=PassConfig(fuse_gemm_add_rms=True, eliminate_noops=True),
+        ),
+    )
+
+    with vllm.config.set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config), monkeypatch.context() as m:
+        from aiter.ops.triton.normalization import fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm as mod
+
+        from vllm.compilation.passes.fusion.rocm_aiter_fusion import (
+            RocmAiterGemmAddRMSNormFusionPass,
+        )
+
+        torch.set_default_device("cuda")
+        torch.set_default_dtype(dtype)
+        torch.manual_seed(1)
+
+        m.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER", "1")
+        m.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_SKINNY_GEMM", "0")
+        rocm_aiter_ops.refresh_env_variables()
+        if not fused_op_available:
+            m.setattr(
+                rocm_aiter_ops, "is_fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm_supported", lambda: False
+            )
+        # Route the GEMM through the AITER Triton kernel whatever the tuned CSV says.
+        m.setattr(
+            "vllm.model_executor.layers.utils._aiter_tuned_gemm_libtype",
+            lambda *args: "triton",
+        )
+        input_ranks = []
+        fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm = mod.fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm
+
+        def spy(x, *args, **kwargs):
+            input_ranks.append(x.dim())
+            return fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm(x, *args, **kwargs)
+
+        m.setattr(mod, "fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm", spy)
+
+        fusion_pass = RocmAiterGemmAddRMSNormFusionPass(vllm_config)
+        passes = [
+            NoOpEliminationPass(vllm_config),
+            fusion_pass,
+            PostCleanupPass(vllm_config),
+        ]
+        backend = TestBackend(*passes)
+        model = TestModel(num_layers, hidden_size, k, gemma_norm)
+
+        x = torch.randn(num_tokens, k)
+        residual = torch.randn(num_tokens, hidden_size)
+        torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic(x, 0)
+        torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic(residual, 0)
+        outputs_unfused = model(x, residual)
+
+        model_fused = torch.compile(model, backend=backend)
+        outputs_fused = model_fused(x, residual)
+
+        # atol: one bf16 ulp at |residual| 4-8; only unfused rounds before the add.
+        torch.testing.assert_close(outputs_unfused, outputs_fused, atol=6e-2, rtol=2e-2)
+
+        if not fused_op_available:
+            # Without the AITER op the pass registers nothing; the graph stays unfused.
+            assert fusion_pass.matched_count == 0 and not input_ranks
+            assert all(backend.op_count(op) > 0 for op in model.ops_in_model_before())
+            assert backend.op_count(model.ops_in_model_after()[0]) == 0
+            return
+
+        assert fusion_pass.matched_count == num_layers
+        assert input_ranks and all(rank == 3 for rank in input_ranks)
+
+        backend.check_before_ops(model.ops_in_model_before())
+        backend.check_after_ops(model.ops_in_model_after())
+        # Gemma norms must take the Gemma form, which folds (1 + w) into the kernel.
+        fused_op = model.ops_in_model_after()[0]
+        names = [a.name for a in fused_op._schema.arguments]
+        fused = list(find_op_nodes(fused_op, backend.graph_post_pass))
+        assert fused and all(
+            dict(zip(names, n.args), **n.kwargs)["gemma_norm"] == gemma_norm
+            for n in fused
+        )

@@ -1704,6 +1704,43 @@ def _rocm_aiter_triton_add_rmsnorm_pad_fake(
     return out, residual_out
 
 
+def _rocm_aiter_gemm_add_rmsnorm_impl(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    variance_epsilon: float,
+    gemma_norm: bool,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    from aiter.ops.triton.normalization.fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm import (
+        fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm,
+    )
+
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.utils import _rocm_unquantized_gemm
+
+    # A 3D result from a 2D input is the split-K partials, reduced by the norm kernel.
+    y = _rocm_unquantized_gemm(x.reshape(-1, x.size(-1)), weight, skip_reduce=True)
+    out, residual_out = fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm(
+        y,
+        residual.reshape(-1, residual.size(-1)),
+        norm_weight,
+        variance_epsilon,
+        gemma_norm=gemma_norm,
+    )
+    return out.view(residual.shape), residual_out.view(residual.shape)
+
+
+def _rocm_aiter_gemm_add_rmsnorm_fake(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    variance_epsilon: float,
+    gemma_norm: bool,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    return torch.empty_like(residual), torch.empty_like(residual)
+
+
 def _fused_mla_dual_rms_norm_impl(

     x1_weight: torch.Tensor,
@@ -3155,6 +3192,13 @@ def register_ops_once() -> None:

@@ -1370,3 +1374,94 @@ def __init__(self, config: VllmConfig) -> None:
             self.register(MLADualRMSNormPattern(epsilon))
             self.register(MLADualRMSPerTokenQuantPattern(epsilon))
             self.register(MLADualRMSGroupQuantPattern(epsilon))
+
+
+class AiterGemmAddRMSNormPattern(VllmPatternReplacement):
+    """Fuse an unquantized GEMM into the residual add + RMSNorm that consumes it."""
+
+    def __init__(self, epsilon: float, gemma_norm: bool) -> None:
+        self.epsilon = epsilon
+        self.gemma_norm = gemma_norm
+        self.GEMM_ADD_RMSNORM_OP = rocm_aiter_ops.get_gemm_add_rmsnorm_op()
+
+    def extra_check(self, match: pm.Match) -> bool:
+        # The plain form must not bind its weight to Gemma's fp32 (w + 1).
+        return self.gemma_norm or _rms_input_weight_dtype_match(match)
+
+    def get_inputs(self) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+        return [
+            self.empty_bf16(5, 32),  # x
+            self.empty_bf16(16, 32),  # weight
+            self.empty_bf16(5, 16),  # residual
+            self.empty_bf16(16),  # norm_weight
+        ]
+
+    @property
+    def pattern(self):
+        def _pattern(
+            x: torch.Tensor,
+            weight: torch.Tensor,
+            residual: torch.Tensor,
+            norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+        ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+            y = torch.ops.vllm.rocm_unquantized_gemm.default(x, weight, None)
+            w = norm_weight.float() + 1.0 if self.gemma_norm else norm_weight
